capabilities: download web images in notes to local storage
batch upload local images to cloud storage or self-hosted gateways
process images with crop, resize, and fill modes
upload or download images across all notes in a vault
clean up local images not linked to any note
extras: Advanced features require running a separate self-hosted gateway service; the plugin is translated into several languages and has a published roadmap.
problem: Obsidian keeps images in the vault, so moving them to remote hosting for blogs or multi-device use means manual uploading and link handling.

relations.evidence: The advanced features of this plugin require the use of Custom Image Gateway.

requires.name: cloud storage service (e.g. Aliyun OSS, Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2)

summary: Image uploader that batch-downloads or uploads note images to self-hosted gateways, WebDAV, NAS, or cloud storage, with crop and resize processing.
